The canonical text represents the partial eta-squared glyph as h2p; metric interpretation follows the ANOVA report. Candidate common participant count is 27 explicitly collected participants, not 30; not inferred from df and no N sum performed. Kept only as candidate evidence because exact critical test is unresolved.
